name: Lysander
epithet: Son of the Gráinne War hero Kleitos
personality: Serious and etiquette-minded, loyal and capable, but rash when chasing achievement of his own.
story: Lysander, 20-21 (25-26 post-timeskip), is the son of Kleitos, a warrior famed for the Gráinne War, and wants to make a name apart from his family legacy. He joins Theodora's route automatically; elsewhere he needs Support 3, 5x Iron Spear, and Renown 8+ (Cai), 6+ (Dietrich), or 7+ (Leda).

personalSkill.name: Racing Attack
personalSkill.effect: If unit attacks first, grants Avo +15 during combat. Lv 20: Accelerate (Spd +1 per foe defeated, max +10); Lv 35: Accelerate+ (Spd +2 per kill, max +10).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: B. KeenGamer: B (evasion build is situational). Reddit: Dragoon becomes a strong mobile attacker once his Str is built (confirmed).

why: Joins Theodora's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.role: Flier: spear striker and armor/cavalry breaker
path: Armored Ornius Rider (Ch 6 to 7: Sense Threat)
build.part1Target: Dragoon at Lv 35 (Ch 11 or 12), Sense Threat and Crescendo mastered
build.notes: Weak stat Dex 35: Crescendo, Besieger and Bonaventure's aura carry his Hit, and he leads with spears (Hit 80). Dragoon carries in from Cai's route. Arena Mounted and Heavy Training take Flying C, Axe B and Spear B; the Archer side trip only adds Crescendo, which he equips to the end.

guide.role: Flier: spear striker and armor/cavalry breaker
guide.summary: The army's mobile striker: a wall-jumping [[class:Armored Ornius Rider]] until Lv 35, then a flying [[class:Dragoon]]. Pick off isolated foes, take kills early so [[ability:Accelerate]] stacks Spd, and break armor and cavalry with the [[item:Ji]]. Attack first (Racing Attack: Avo +15) and never end in two archers' range.
guide.playstyle: Player-phase picker. Open each map on weak foes so Accelerate and Crescendo stack, lead with spears (Hit 80 vs 65 on axes) and bring the Ji for armor and cavalry. As a Dragoon, fight foes on forests and forts: Besieger adds Hit +20.
keys: Master Armored Ornius Rider by Ch 8: Sense Threat (Avo +20) is his bow answer later.
Book Arena Mounted and Heavy Training for Flying C, Axe B, Spear B by Lv 35.
Use the Ch 7 Cindered Road Cave Flying Manual on him.
Ch 8: Archer for Crescendo only if Bow is C and the three Dragoon ranks are on track.
Lead with the [[item:Da Mina Spear]] (Spear C, Ch 6); swing the Iron Axe only on safe kills for Axe rank.
Part II Ch 2: reach the southeast Ranger before Turn 4 for the [[item:Cleansing Blade]] +1.
watch: Weight: Da Mina Spear 7 + Gale Ring 2 = 9 in Parts I-II. Part III: Iron Spear +4 7 + Kalla's Needle 4 = 11 (extra 4); Javelin +2 throws only. Short of a double? Gale Ring for the Needle on that map.
Bows: Effective+ on him once he flies. Sense Threat (Avo +20) helps, but archers can still one-shot a Dragoon on Hard: check the purple lines first.
Axe Hit: Iron Axe Hit 65 on Dex 35. Stack Crescendo (max +30), Besieger (+20 on terrain) and Bonaventure's aura (+10/+20, 30%) before an axe swing.
Inventory: 6/6 in Ch 10 to 12 (Da Mina Spear, Ji, Short Spear, Iron Axe, Gale Ring, Concoction). Into Part II leave the Short Spear: slot 6 takes the Cleansing Blade.

decisions.topic: Take the Archer side trip if on track
decisions.pick: Archer in Ch 8 to 9, only with Bow C and the Dragoon ranks on track
decisions.why: Crescendo (Hit +3 a kill, max +30) stays equipped to Part III and fixes his Dex 35; Archer also grows Dex +10. Alexandra flies from Ch 9, so the army lacks a flier only in Ch 8.
decisions.else: Stay Armored Ornius Rider to Lv 35

decisions.pick: Dragoon in Ch 11 or 12 (unlocked on Cai's route)
decisions.why: The only flying class with Axe and Spear: Mov 7, Besieger, and Axe +3, Flying +3 training toward Bau Lord's Axe A.
decisions.else: A rank short at Lv 35: stay Armored Ornius Rider; Dragoon on a Part II Ch 1 License

decisions.topic: Carry a Cleansing Blade in Part III
decisions.pick: Cleansing Blade (Sword E) on the Bau Lord
decisions.why: Spears and axes can't strip the Underworld Boon, but Bau Lord holds swords. Take the Part II Ch 2 drop, or barter one at Vandahl (Ladon Pike x3) if it doesn't carry.
decisions.else: Fight undead only on Aurora's Lv 3 blessing turn or next to Eshmel
